experiment_data.hypothesis: Removing evidence output from LLaMA-3.1-8B RSFT model will improve ign_f1 by freeing generation capacity for relation extraction, similar to the Qwen3-8B no-evidence ablation.

spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/freige && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python -m freige.eval.inference --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output_llama_3_1_8b_k1 --base_model /root/autodl-tmp/models/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output_llama_3_1_8b --data_path /root/autodl-tmp/data/docred --split dev --batch_size 4 --max_new_tokens 1024 --seed 42 --no-quantize --no_evidence --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/eval_llama_rsft_s42_no_evidence
